LanguageData.VGE_OpportunitySite_InfestedAsteroid.que:
questDescription->[discoveryMethod] the location of an asteroid infested with insectoids. The creatures have carved tunnels into the rock, filling them with debris and salvage from passing wrecks.

The asteroid could hold great value, but the infestation will not be easy to dislodge. You detect clear signs of insectoid activity.

You can reach the asteroid with transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion. Equip your colonists with sufficient orbital apparel before departing.
LanguageData.VGE_OpportunitySite_DormantWarplatform.q:
questDescription->[discoveryMethod] the location of a dormant, automated warplatform. This hostile satellite is filled with anti-aircraft defenses and gauss bombards that will open fire the moment you land.

The platform is heavily defended by security turrets, sentry drones, and mechanical traps. At its center is a warcomputer coordinating the network. If your colonists can survive the landing and hack or destroy the warcomputer, the bombards will be disabled and the platform can be salvaged.

You can reach the warplatform with transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion. Equip your colonists with sufficient orbital apparel before departing.
LanguageData.VGE_OpportunitySite_VacstoneMeteor.quest: questDescription->A large meteorite has struck ground nearby. It has left behind a lump of vacstone. Vacstone is required for constructing more advanced Hellion systems. You can send a mining party to retrieve it, but if you wait long enough someone else will lay claim to it.
LanguageData.VGE_OpportunitySite_DerelictGravship.que: questDescription->[discoveryMethod] the location of a derelict Hellion. This ancient aircraft, ruined by countless years in orbit, is a trove of salvage, including rare gravlite and advanced components.\n\nThe wreck is currently [threatDescription], making any attempt at recovery dangerous. You can reach the location with transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion. Equip your colonists with sufficient orbital apparel before departing.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipGraveyard.questDescriptionRu: questDescription->You have detected the distinct energy signature of a reactor core emanating from a massive field of debris: a Hellion graveyard. You know that when you arrive, your navigation systems will be locked. An ancient signal jammer is active within the debris field, preventing your Hellion from initiating launch. You must navigate through unstable ancient gravmines, locate the source of the jamming, and neutralize it to escape.\n\nBe careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedInstallation.questDescriptio: questDescription->You have detected the energy signature of a reactor core. The signal is coming from an abandoned orbital station infested with exoinsectoids. Scans reveal numerous hives on board. You must navigate the infested ruins, defeat the exoinsectoid defenders, and destroy the infested gravlock tether, which will continue spawning new exoinsectoids throughout the platform. Once it is destroyed, you will be able to obtain the reactor core.\n\nBe careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerStronghold.questDescriptionR:
questDescription->You have detected the distinct energy signature of a reactor core emanating from a large asteroid. Scans reveal that a well-armed faction of salvagers has claimed the rock, building a heavily defended stronghold upon it. An active enemy signal jammer prevents your Hellion from landing nearby, forcing you to touch down on the dangerous outskirts.

You must assault the base, navigate its defenses, and destroy the gravlock tether in the center of the compound to obtain the reactor core.

Be careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
